description: Benchmark retrieval set: requirement sentences phrased the way Indian tenders phrase them, with no standard citations. `standards` maps standard id → graded relevance (2 = governing, 1 = acceptable/related); `clauses` lists governing clause ids. Written before the system was run on them.

queries.text: The LT switchboard shall be suitable for operation in a room where the air temperature may reach 45 deg C.
The panel will be installed at a hill station at an elevation of 2400 m.
The switchboard enclosure shall be protected against dust ingress and water splashing.
The busbar system shall withstand the prospective fault current for one second without damage.
The main PCC shall have Form 4 separation between functional units.
Factory tests on each completed switchboard shall include a dielectric test and checking of wiring and operation.
Temperature-rise performance of the assembly shall be demonstrated by test or by calculation.
Enclosure tests for protection against ingress of solid foreign objects and water shall be conducted.
Every final circuit of the house wiring shall have overload and short circuit protection.
An earth leakage circuit breaker of 30 mA shall be installed for bathroom socket circuits.
Miniature circuit breakers for lighting circuits shall have C curve tripping characteristics.
Moulded case circuit breakers shall have an ultimate breaking capacity of 36 kA.
Building wires shall be PVC insulated copper conductor rated 450/750 V.
Armoured PVC insulated heavy duty power cables for 1.1 kV working voltage.
XLPE insulated cables shall permit a conductor temperature of 90 deg C in continuous operation.
Conductors shall be stranded aluminium class 2 with maximum DC resistance as per the relevant standard.
Cables shall be subjected to high voltage test and conductor resistance test at the factory.
The earth pit resistance shall be measured with an earth tester by the fall of potential method.
Plate type earth electrode of GI 600 x 600 x 6 mm shall be provided with charcoal and salt filling.
The neutral and protective earth shall be kept separate throughout the installation.
Three phase squirrel cage motors shall run satisfactorily with the supply voltage varying by 10 percent.
The motor nameplate shall show output, voltage, current, speed and efficiency.
Motors shall be of premium efficiency IE3 class.
No-load and locked rotor tests shall be performed on each motor.
The motor enclosure shall be totally enclosed fan cooled with IP55 protection.
Oil immersed distribution transformer of 250 kVA, 11/0.433 kV, outdoor type.
Transformer losses shall comply with energy efficiency level 3.
Impulse voltage withstand and temperature rise tests shall be carried out on one unit of each rating.
The centrifugal pump for clear cold water shall deliver the rated discharge at the duty head.
The pump casing shall be of cast iron and the impeller of bronze.
Performance test of the pump at the works shall be conducted as a Class C acceptance test.
Borewell submersible pumpset shall deliver 10 m3/h at 60 m head with overall efficiency not less than 45 %.
The motor of the submersible pumpset shall be of water filled rewindable type.
Concrete in foundations exposed to sea water spray shall be of minimum grade M35.
Clear cover to main reinforcement in columns exposed to moderate environment shall be 40 mm.
Maximum free water cement ratio for RCC in severe exposure shall be 0.45.
Coarse aggregate shall be crushed stone of 20 mm nominal size, free from clay lumps and other deleterious material.
TMT reinforcement bars shall be Fe 500D with minimum elongation of 16 percent.
The concrete mix shall be designed for the target mean strength with standard deviation assumed as per the guidelines.
Compressive strength of concrete cubes shall be tested at 7 and 28 days.
Ordinary Portland cement of 43 grade shall be used.
Structural steel sections shall be of grade E250 hot rolled steel.
Potable water supplied shall have total dissolved solids within the acceptable limit.
Fluoride concentration in drinking water shall be within 1.0 mg/l.
Water shall be free from coliform bacteria.
Bacteriological samples shall be collected in sterilised bottles and examined by the MPN method.
Physical and chemical parameters of water shall be analysed by the standard methods.
Packaged drinking water units shall hold a valid BIS licence.
Hardness of treated water as CaCO3 shall not exceed 200 mg/l.
Arsenic in groundwater sources shall be tested and shall not exceed 0.01 mg/l.
